programme.title: Until Judge Do Us Part
programme.desc: Massimo, Paolo, Roberto and Mauro are four friends, all separated. Massimo is the freshest in separation and the judge has taken everything from him: the house, the daughter and forced him to pay a large monthly check to his wife. The three friends stand by him to hearten him and give him advice on coping with the separation and getting back to living a normal life, but surprises are just around the corner.

programme.title: Who Finds a Friend Finds a Treasure
programme.desc: Alan, a gambler, drains his uncle's savings and takes refuge on Charlie's boat, on a cruise. programme.title: Love hurts
programme.desc: Germana is an untalented and unlucky aspiring actress, a somewhat inconsiderate mother and the mistress of a rich lawyer who supports her financially. Elisabetta, her neighbour, on the other hand, is a successful doctor, too closed in her schemes to realise her husband is homosexual until she is left alone with many questions. When Gianmarco, a family man in a work crisis, saves Germana's daughter from an accident, sparks fly between them. Too bad she does not know that he is married and is Elisabetta's friend. Fate brings them face to face with reality when, during a holiday in Sicily, they all meet again, forcing them to confront each other.

programme.title: Smile Before Death
programme.desc: Marco, a penniless nobleman, unhappily married to the wealthy Dorothy Emerson, has a lover, Gianna. She, one day, rids him of his irritating spouse, killing her. Having automatically become the administrator of his estate - which, however, he must pass on to Nancy, Dorothy's first-born daughter, when he turns twenty - he retires to live with Gianna in a luxurious villa on the shores of a lake. Here he is joined by the pretty future heiress, whom he had never met. In order not to have to give up the enjoyment of her wealth, Gianna incites Marco to kill the girl. The man, however, ends up falling in love with her and so does Gianna.
